name: 14-Cinnamoyloxycodeinone
summary: 14-Cinnamoyloxycodeinone is the most potent example in a series of opiate analgesic drugs discovered in the 1960s, with over 100 times the potency of morphine. It is a derivative of hydroxycodeinone, being the 14-cinnamate ester. In another paper, Buckett assigns the potency as 177 with a range (depending on animal and test) of 101–310×.

pharmacology.en: As a very strong opiate painkiller, it is thought to act like morphine on the mu-opioid receptor.
pharmacology.zh: 作為一種極強的鴉片類止痛藥，它被認為和嗎啡一樣作用於μ型鴉片受體。
pharmacology.zhHans: 作为一种极强的鸦片类止痛药，它被认为和吗啡一样作用于μ型鸦片受体。

uses.en: It was studied in the 1960s and was never used as a medicine.
uses.zh: 它在1960年代被研究過，從未作為藥物使用。
uses.zhHans: 它在1960年代被研究过，从未作为药物使用。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing and kill. They also cause dependence, with a hard withdrawal. Its very high strength makes overdose more likely.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量可能使呼吸停止而致命。這類藥物也會造成依賴，戒斷過程辛苦。它的效力極強，更容易過量。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量可能使呼吸停止而致命。这类药物也会造成依赖，戒断过程辛苦。它的效力极强，更容易过量。

fact.en: Its cinnamoyl group comes from cinnamic acid, a close chemical cousin of the compound that gives cinnamon its smell.
fact.zh: 它的肉桂醯基來自肉桂酸，肉桂酸與賦予肉桂香氣的化合物是近親。
fact.zhHans: 它的肉桂酰基来自肉桂酸，肉桂酸与赋予肉桂香气的化合物是近亲。
